description: §22.12 (S459 review F2) — page markup names elements `querySelector` / `implementation`, which can shadow `document.querySelector` / `document.implementation` (document named properties). The gate and the insertion read `document` only through accessors captured from the prototypes, so an admitted `meta.emit` string still renders at its placeholder.
rationale: §22.12 step 2: every `document` facility the gate and the insertion use is read through accessors markup cannot shadow. (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S458 "a" + PA addendum 3 (S459 review of a7480c675))
